title: Grave Photo Request Completion Lag
dataSources: Hints (`genealogy:hint`), cemetery visits (`genealogy:cemetery`), family-photo work (`genealogy:photo`), research ops (`genealogy:ops`).
app: Genealogy and family-history telemetry — Ancestry hints, cemetery visit logs, and photo-restoration queues — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=genealogy:cemetery memorial_site=* requested_epoch=* fulfilled_epoch=*
| eval lag_days=round((fulfilled_epoch-requested_epoch)/86400,1)
| stats avg(lag_days) as avg_lag_days, max(lag_days) as worst_lag_days by memorial_site
| sort - avg_lag_days
description: Measures photo-request lag by memorial site for grave-photo requests.
value: Lag tracking shows which memorial site create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside grave-photo requests.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `photo-request lag` on `genealogy:cemetery` events and aggregate them by `memorial_site`.
visualization: Table of memorial site with average and worst photo-request lag.
grandmaExplanation: It flags how long things take for each memorial site so you can see where grave-photo requests slows down.
